informal_statement: Euclidean Hausdorff measure restricted to the complete frontier, transported to coordinates.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At CMVGeometry.lean:61-66, the source contract is `def FrontierMeasure (carrier : Set PlanePoint) : Measure PlanePoint := Measure.map planeEuclideanHomeomorph.symm ((μH[1] : Measure EuclideanPlane).restrict (frontier (planeEuclideanHomeomorph '' carrier)))`. FrontierMeasure is the pullback, through the coordinate-preserving Euclidean homeomorphism, of H^1 restricted to the complete topological frontier. Neither the product sup norm nor an independently chosen boundary measure is used.
